create_GPTQMarlinConfig: create a GPTQMarlinConfig instance to configure 4-bit or 8-bit GPTQ Marlin quantization for vLLM models
build_GPTQMarlinLinearMethod: build a GPTQMarlinLinearMethod to apply GPTQ Marlin quantization to linear layers with packed weights and scales
build_GPTQMarlinMoEMethod: build a GPTQMarlinMoEMethod to apply GPTQ Marlin quantization to fused MoE layers with w13 and w2 expert weights
test_is_gptq_marlin_compatible: test whether a model's quantization config is compatible with GPTQ Marlin runtime conversion
run_fused_marlin_moe_apply: run the fused_marlin_moe kernel to perform quantized MoE inference with top-k expert selection
